correctness.rationale: For every a,r>0, the three-vertex signed area is separately affine, reducing vertices to two generating disks. The exact two-disk chord bound sqrt(r²-d²)(2a+r+d), with equality witnesses, reduces global optimization to one strictly unimodal scalar function. Equality conditions and convex mixtures establish exactly two triangle maximizers. Their centrally symmetric hexagon tiles at determinant 2M3; the classical Bambah–Rogers theorem bounds every lattice covering determinant by 2M3. The envelope derivative proves strict area-fraction monotonicity and endpoint limits. Verified standalone checker supplies supportive, nonexhaustive computations, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite family of convex geometry bodies (Euclidean stadiums) has a nontrivial exact maximal-triangle classification. Via the classical covering theorem this gives the sharp lattice-covering density, an explicit attaining lattice, strict aspect-ratio dependence and shape recovery. These are geometrically meaningful optimal packing/covering invariants not implied by a generic algorithm or a routine normalization.
